units.text: 6. Authorized officials of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation consider cases concerning administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on behalf of the bodies specified in point 3 of part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 22.2

units.text: 7. Officials authorized to consider administrative offence cases possess those powers in full, unless otherwise established by Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 22.2

units.text: 8. An official who directly participated in a control (supervision) measure or inspection and initiated an administrative offence case on the basis of indications of an administrative offence event identified during that measure or inspection may not consider that administrative offence case, except in the cases provided for by Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 22.2

units.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.text: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.label: Art. 22.3

units.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.label: Art. 22.3

units.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.text: 1. If a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies, or an official post specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is abolished, judges consider the administrative offence cases within its jurisdiction until the corresponding amendments and additions are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22.3

units.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.text: 2. If a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is transformed, otherwise reorganized or placed under different authority, the body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies to which those functions have been transferred consider the administrative offence cases within its jurisdiction until the corresponding amendments and additions are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22.3

units.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
units.text: 3. If the name of a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies, or an official post specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changes, the officials of that body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies continue exercising their powers to consider administrative offence cases until the corresponding amendments are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22.3

units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.3

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 1) heads of territorial internal affairs directorates (departments) and equivalent internal affairs authorities, their deputies, deputy chiefs of police (for the protection of public order), heads of territorial police departments (divisions, posts) and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 5 of Article 5.26, part 2 of Article 6.8, part 2 of Article 6.9, part 4 of Article 6.13, part 2 of Article 6.16.1, parts 5 - 8 of Article 6.21, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.1, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.2, Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), Articles 8.22, 8.23, 10.4 and 10.5, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), Article 13.24, parts 2 and 5 of Article 14.4.1, parts 2.1 and 3 of Article 14.16, Articles 14.16.1 and 14.26, part 2 of Article 14.53, part 1.1 of Article 18.2 (within their powers), Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.2, 19.8.3 and 19.15 - 19.18, part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads), parts 1 and 2 of Article 19.24, Article 19.27, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, Articles 20.20 and 20.21, and parts 4 and 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 2) heads of line transport police departments (directorates), their deputies and deputy chiefs of police (for the protection of public order) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17, Articles 13.24 and 14.26, part 2 of Article 14.53, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 18.8, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 3) heads of duty shifts in the duty units of line transport police departments (directorates), and heads of line police divisions (posts) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17, Article 13.24, part 2 of Article 14.53, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, part 1 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 4) heads of duty shifts in the duty units of line transport police departments (directorates), heads of line police divisions (posts), and other police officers entrusted with supervising compliance with the relevant rules — concerning administrative offences committed on railway transport and provided for by Article 6.24 (for violations committed on railway transport), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17 (for violations committed on railway transport), and part 2 of Article 14.53 (for violations committed on railway transport) of this Code;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 5) the head of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate, his or her deputy, the head of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate centre for automated recording of administrative offences in the field of road traffic, his or her deputy, the commander of a road patrol service regiment (battalion, company), and his or her deputy — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23, 11.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1, 2 and 3.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, parts 2 - 6 and part 7 (where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions) of Article 12.9, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.10, Articles 12.11 - 3, part 3.1 (where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), part 4 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 23.79 of this Code), part 5 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1 of Article 23.79 of this Code) and parts 6 - 8 of Article 12.16, Articles 12.17 - 12.21, 12.21.2, 12.22 and 12.23, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, part 1 of Article 12.27, Articles 12.28 - 12.31, 12.31.1 (except passenger taxis), 12.32, 12.33, 12.36.1 and 12.37, part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads), and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 6) officers of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate holding a special rank — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 12.1, part 1 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, parts 1, 1.1 and 3.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 2, 3 and 6 of Article 12.9, part 2 of Article 12.10, Article 12.11, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.12, Articles 12.13 and 12.14, parts 1 - 3 of Article 12.15, parts 1 and 2, part 4 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 23.79 of this Code), part 5 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1 of Article 23.79 of this Code) and parts 6 - 8 of Article 12.16, parts 1 - 1.2 of Article 12.17, Articles 12.18 - 12.20, part 1 of Article 12.21, Articles 12.22, 12.23 and 12.28, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.29, part 1 of Article 12.30, Articles 12.36.1 and 12.37, and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 7) senior state road traffic safety inspectors and state road traffic safety inspectors — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22 and 8.23, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.31, Articles 12.32 and 12.32.1, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 8) senior state road supervision inspectors and state road supervision inspectors — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 12.33 of this Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 9) senior local police commissioners and local police commissioners — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), Articles 10.4, 10.5 and 12.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, Articles 12.22, 12.23 and 12.28, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.29, part 1 of Article 12.30, Articles 19.2, 19.15, 19.15.1 and 19.15.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 19.24, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 10) the head of the migration division of the central administration of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1.1 of Article 18.2, Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.8.3, 19.15 - 19.18 and 19.27, and parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 20.25 of this Code;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 11) heads of structural migration divisions of territorial authorities and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1.1 of Article 18.2, Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.8.3, 19.15 - 19.18 and 19.27, and parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 20.25 of this Code;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 12) heads of structural drug control divisions of territorial authorities and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 6.8, part 2 of Article 6.9, part 4 of Article 6.13, Articles 10.4 and 10.5, and parts 2 and 3 of Article 20.20 of this Code.
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 23.3

units.text: 3. The officials specified in item 3 of part 2 of this Article shall be entitled to impose administrative penalties on citizens and officials in the form of a warning or an administrative fine of up to five thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.3

units.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.text: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.label: Art. 23.4

units.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.label: Art. 23.4

units.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.text: 1. Authorities and institutions of the penal enforcement system and pretrial detention facilities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 19.3 and Article 19.12 (with respect to administrative offences involving items withdrawn from circulation) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.4

units.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
units.text: 2. Heads of arrest houses, correctional institutions, pretrial detention facilities and temporary detention facilities shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities and institutions specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.4

units.text: Article 23.5. Tax Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.5

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.5. Tax Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.5

units.text: 1. Tax authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 4 - 17 of Article 14.5, part 5 of Article 14.13, Article 15.1, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 15.48 (within their powers), and Article 19.7.6 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.5

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.5

units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.5

units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.5

units.text: 3) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.5
